answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 26 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in pearl, queued in nadir, and ridge publishes the wait time. A farm of 377 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1221 identities would post 4617 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
